tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the ISMS Directory catalog of ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, DORA, NIS 2 and other compliance service providers (consultants, auditors, platforms, training). Filters are exact tags; several frameworks are combined with AND. Use list_categories first if you are unsure of a tag. Results are sorted by name, not ranked. Same data as GET https://ismsdirectory.com/api/search.

q.description: Natural-language query mapped to filters, e.g. 'ISO 27001 consultants in Germany with DORA'. Ignored for a dimension when that dimension's explicit filter is set.

frameworks.description: Framework tags, e.g. ['ISO 27001', 'DORA']. AND across values.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Full public profile of one listed service (description, frameworks, regions, industries, client sizes, languages, website, directory page). Matches the name case-insensitively, then by partial name.

name.description: Service or company name as listed, e.g. 'ISMS Copilot'.

tools.name: check_if_listed
tools.description: Check whether a company is listed in the ISMS Directory. Returns the listing when found, close matches otherwise, and the paid submission link when it is not listed.

company_name.description: Company or product name to look up.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every tag used in one catalog dimension with the number of listed services carrying it. Use the returned tags as exact filter values for search_services.
